_comment: A4A MCP Gateway configuration — copy the relevant section to your MCP config file. Replace <GATEWAY_URL>, <AWS_PROFILE> and <AWS_REGION> with your deployment's values; the gateway URL is printed by Phase 12 and stored in .quick-gw-<PREFIX>-<UID>.json.

mcpServers._comment_primary: PRIMARY: mcp-proxy-for-aws (official AWS, SigV4 native, no token management)
mcpServers._comment_fallback: FALLBACK: npx mcp-remote (if you prefer Node.js or need OAuth for non-AWS auth)
